## Why This Is Asked

Assess practical ability to instrument and diagnose across a CNPA stack, ensuring end-to-end visibility and data-driven tuning of tail latency.

## Key Concepts

- Distributed tracing
- OpenTelemetry
- Context propagation
- Sampling and backends
- End-to-end latency metrics

